newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA LAUNCHES LEASING FIRM - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA LAUNCHES LEASING FIRM - REPORT.

text.p: Unibanka, the second largest Latvian bank in assets has launched a leasing firm, newspaper Diena said on Thursday.
Unibanka has created a daughter company, Unilizings, as the demand for leasing services widens, Diena said.
Leasing rates range between 15 to 24 percent, based on Unibanka's loan interest rates, with the leasing term between one to five years.
The first payment comprises 10 to 20 percent of the product's price, the newspaper added.
Unilizings is currently mainly engaged in supporting companies which invest in machinery.
Individuals can use leasing agreements to buy cars, houses and flats. Unilizings plans to offer flat leasing agreements for ten-year term, it added.
